name: io.github.jams4code/cypress-mcp
title: cypress-mcp
description: Run and debug Cypress tests from an AI agent: compact failures with file:line, error, screenshot.

packageArguments.name: --cwd
packageArguments.description: Root of the Cypress project (the folder with cypress.config.*). Defaults to CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR when Claude Code sets it, else the directory the client starts the server in.

packageArguments.name: --caps
packageArguments.description: Optional tool groups, comma separated: analyze, config, legacy (the 0.2 tool names), or all.

environmentVariables.name: CYPRESS_RECORD_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Cypress Cloud record key. Only needed to record runs with record: true; never passed through the agent.
